why_notable: Chapoutier's Hermitage is one of the Northern Rhône's most prestigious expressions of Syrah, known for power and aging potential.
An iconic Northern Rhône wine that defined the quality potential of Hermitage with its depth, structure, and legendary aging ability.
Chave's Hermitage is considered among the finest expressions of the appellation, representing traditional winemaking excellence and complexity.
Part of Guigal's legendary La La La trilogy, La Landonne represents the dark, mineral style of Côte-Rôtie's western hillside.
Guigal's second La La La wine, La Turque showcases the floral, perfumed characteristics of Côte-Rôtie with remarkable finesse and age-worthiness.
The third of Guigal's famous trilogy, La Mouline offers elegance and complexity from the eastern slopes of Côte-Rôtie.
Rostaing's Côte-Rôtie represents the traditional approach to the appellation with aromatic complexity and silky tannins.
Ogier's Côte-Rôtie exemplifies modern Northern Rhône winemaking, combining power with elegance and aromatics.
Jamet's Côte-Rôtie is renowned for its precision, balance, and expression of the appellation's terroir with minimal intervention.
Clape's Cornas is the definitive expression of the appellation, showcasing muscular, structured Syrah with legendary aging potential.
Cuilleron's Condrieu represents the finest white wine from the Northern Rhône, with aromatic intensity and minerality.
Vernay's Condrieu is a benchmark for the appellation, demonstrating the potential of Viognier with complexity and elegance.
Chave's Saint-Joseph demonstrates that this appellation can produce serious, age-worthy red wines of remarkable quality.

grapes: Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre, Cinsault, Counoise, Cariñena, Picpoul Noir
why_notable: Beaucastel is one of the Southern Rhône's most prestigious estates, known for blends that balance power with elegance and complexity.
Rayas produces one of Châteauneuf's most legendary wines, made primarily from old-vine Grenache with silky texture and depth.
Vieux Télégraphe is an iconic Châteauneuf-du-Pape offering wonderful balance, structure, and aging potential at the highest level.
Clos des Papes produces exceptional Châteauneuf with remarkable fruit purity, balance, and the ability to age gracefully for decades.
Vieux Donjon produces reliable, well-made Châteauneuf-du-Pape that combines ripe fruit with structure and excellent value.
Domaine du Vieux Télégraphe's Gigondas offers Southern Rhône depth and richness at a more accessible price point than Châteauneuf.
Saint-Cosme's Gigondas is renowned for its aromatic intensity, bold structure, and excellent representation of the appellation's character.
Les Pallières produces elegant Gigondas with impressive aging potential and the ability to express the terroir's complexity.
Domaine de la Côte's Vacqueyras demonstrates the quality potential of this appellation with ripe fruit, structure, and complexity.
Amouriers produces excellent Vacqueyras showing the appellation's potential for producing serious, age-worthy Southern Rhône wines.
Montfaucon's Vacqueyras offers Southern Rhône warmth and generosity with good structure and aging potential at mid-premium pricing.
Chapoutier's white Hermitage showcases the potential of Marsanne and Roussanne with mineral precision and remarkable aging capability.
Villa's white Côte-Rôtie made from Viognier represents a rare and elegant expression of the traditionally red appellation.
Allemand's Cornas is crafted with biodynamic methods and represents modern Cornas winemaking with power, precision, and aging potential.
Fauconnier's Hermitage represents a careful selection of top parcels, offering the appellation's classic blend of power and elegance.
